steps.syncopation: Syncopation moves the accent off the beat: a note starts on an “and” and is held through the next beat, so that beat is felt but not played. Keep counting steadily and let the long note sit across the beat.
steps.tapSyncopation: Tap the off-beat rhythms, counting the beats under them.
steps.offBeat: Off the beat, then on it.
steps.offBeatInTime: Now in time: the metronome clicks the beats you don’t play.
